QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] End of the Dream
QuestInfo.0: The Fog of Oblivion spread out. Now listen to #bGrendel the Really Old#k.
QuestInfo.1: You reported what happened so far at the Conference Pavilion. The link with the nightmare has dimmed. The people of Maple World will no longer suffer from it.
QuestInfo.2: The case of the <false future> is closed. However, the Black Mage's new Commander, who created the dream world, still remains. The day will come when you meet that new Commander.

1.0: The case of the <false future> is closed. However, it's not over yet. The Black Mage's new Commander, who created the dream world, still remains.
1.1: The #bAlliance#k has officially begun, with a newly powerful #bEmpress Cygnus#k in command. But the enemy is no pushover. The #rBlack Mage#k is steadily strengthening his forces with #rnew Commanders#k.
1.2: The alliance will investigate this #rnew Commander#k. #b#h0##k, you've been a massive help, as usual. Thank you.

yes.0: You should take a good rest after all that. Or go continue training, if you like. No doubt the Alliance will have another assignment for you shortly.

npc.0: Did you wall off the nighmare? Oh, that's amazing. Can you come and tell everyone how you did it? We'll be at the Conference Pavilion.
